description.value: Happy Sushi is a neighbourhood Japanese restaurant on Victoria Drive in Vancouver offering a broad menu of sushi, nigiri, donburi, tempura, ramen, and udon. The restaurant emphasises fresh, high-quality ingredients and serves both dine-in and takeout customers. It is a practical meal stop for cyclists exploring the Victoria Drive corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 8m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 28m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 30m; stands (3 spaces) at 61m; stands (2 spaces) at 97m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an open Japanese restaurant offering dine-in and takeout ('Order Pickup', 'dine-in or take-out meals'). There is a notable address discrepancy: OSM lists 5632 Victoria Drive while the website clearly states 5137 Victoria Dr, Vancouver, BC V5P3V1 — the website value is preferred. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records 5632 Victoria Drive but the business website clearly states 5137 Victoria Dr, Vancouver, BC V5P3V1. The OSM node coordinates should be verified against the website address.
OSM record has no phone number; website provides (604) 428-6688 — OSM should be updated.
Discovered URL (happysushivancouverbc.com) was not present in OSM tags; was found via discovery process.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed open Japanese restaurant with dine-in and takeout on a city cycling corridor; a practical food stop for touring cyclists once the address discrepancy is resolved.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian items: Vegetable Tempura, Yam Tempura, Pumpkin Tempura, Vegetable Udon, Agedashi Tofu, Edamame, Seaweed Salad, Gomaae Spinach Salad, and Inari Nigiri. No explicit vegan or GF labelling observed
